title: Imamate of Futa Jallon founded
description: Fulani and Muslim allies defeat the old animist rulers and build a theocratic state around Timbo that holds the interior for nearly two centuries.

title: Samori founds the Wassoulou Empire
description: The trader-warrior Samori Toure, lord of the Dyula states south of the Niger, takes the religious title almamy and builds a fortified capital at Bissandugu.

title: Conakry founded by the French
description: After Britain cedes the island to France, a small village on Tombo Island grows into the colonial capital and main port of the Rivières du Sud.

title: French Guinea created
description: France organises its coastal holdings as the separate colony of French Guinea.

title: Samori captured
description: After seven years of war and a scorched-earth retreat eastward, Samori Toure is caught by a French detachment and exiled to Gabon, ending organised resistance to French rule in the region.

title: Guinea votes No to de Gaulle
description: Guinea is the only French African territory to reject the constitution of the Fifth Republic, and France cuts off all aid and withdraws within weeks.

title: Independence proclaimed
description: Sékou Touré proclaims independence, and Guinea becomes the first French West African colony to leave.

title: Operation Green Sea
description: Portuguese commandos and Guinean exiles raid Conakry to free prisoners and overthrow Touré; the attack fails and hardens the regime.

title: Death of Sékou Touré
description: Guinea's president since independence dies after heart surgery in the United States, ending twenty-six years of single-party rule and prison camps.

title: Conté seizes power
description: Colonel Lansana Conté leads a bloodless army coup before the party can choose a successor and dissolves the PDG state.

title: Return to civilian rule announced
description: Conté announces a return to civilian rule, with a presidential poll in 1993 and parliament in 1995, without yielding real power.

title: First multiparty presidential election
description: Conté wins a presidential election the opposition calls rigged, continuing his rule in civilian form.

title: Cross-border attacks
description: Rebel incursions from Sierra Leone and Liberia devastate the forest prefectures crowded with refugees from those civil wars.

title: General strike
description: Weeks of strikes and street battles force the ailing Conté to cede day-to-day power to a consensus prime minister.

title: Dadis Camara coup
description: Hours after Conté's death is announced, junior officers under Moussa Dadis Camara seize power and suspend the constitution.

title: Stadium massacre
description: Security forces fire on an opposition rally in the national stadium, killing well over a hundred people and raping scores.

title: Dadis Camara shot
description: The junta leader is seriously wounded by his aide-de-camp and goes abroad for treatment, leaving General Konaté to organise a transition.

title: Alpha Condé elected
description: The veteran opposition leader Alpha Condé wins the run-off of Guinea's first broadly free presidential election.

title: Condé re-elected
description: Condé wins a second term in the first round, a result rejected by the opposition.

title: Constitutional protests
description: Mass demonstrations against a new constitution that would let Condé seek a third term are met with repeated live fire.
